title: Deliver Rubber to Dadston Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Rubber** delivered to **Dadston Factory** (industry id 8, near tile 40,47).

A likely supplier is **Dadston Rubber Plantation** (industry id 6, near tile 18,44); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **490 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
